taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Posterior triangle of neck.

words.clue: This muscle forms the posterior boundary of the posterior triangle of the neck.
Muscle whose inferior belly divides the posterior triangle into occipital and subclavian subdivisions.
Thin, superficial muscle that contributes to the roof of the posterior triangle.
Cranial nerve (CN XI) that runs obliquely through the posterior triangle and is at risk during lymph node biopsy.
Bony process of the skull where the sternocleidomastoid muscle inserts superiorly.
Larger subdivision of the posterior triangle that contains brachial plexus roots.
Condition characterized by head tilt to one side and chin rotation to the opposite side, also called wryneck.
Plexus formed by nerve roots C5 through T1 that emerges between scalenus anterior and medius.
Artery and vein that pass through the lower triangle subdivision, coursing behind scalenus anterior.
Cervical muscle that forms part of the floor of the posterior triangle.
Bone whose middle third forms the inferior base of the posterior triangle.
Scapulae muscle that forms part of the posterior triangle floor over the prevertebral fascia.
